parts.script:
Anna: Hi Tom, did you manage to visit the farmers' market this weekend?  
Tom: Yes, I did! It was bustling with people. I went early in the morning.  
Anna: That's great! What did you buy?  
Tom: I got some fresh vegetables, a few fruits, and even a homemade pie!  
Anna: A pie? That sounds delicious! Was it expensive?  
Tom: Not really, it was only $10. The fruits and vegetables were quite reasonable too.  
Anna: Did you see anything unusual at the market?  
Tom: Actually, I did. There was a stall selling handmade candles, and they had all sorts of unique scents. I bought a lavender one!  
Anna: That sounds lovely! Did you talk to any of the vendors?  
Tom: Yes, I spoke to a lady selling organic honey. She was very passionate about her products.  
Anna: I love local markets. They really bring the community together.  
Tom: Exactly! Plus, it’s a great way to support local farmers and artisans.  
Anna: I should definitely go next weekend.  
Tom: You should! You'll have a great time!
